$comment: The reviewed label list of the map atlas (docs/research/map-atlas.md §6.5; D-042 A11 and O11). Read by tools/maps/atlas.ts; checked by pnpm maps:validate (T7, T9).

Each entry is one painted label a rule applies to: the painting (uiMapId), the label box in source pixels [x0, y0, x1, y1], the rule (whole: drawn whole across its painting's polygon, coastal band or frame edge; hide: removed by a mirror fill from the same painting), the levels (all, or fine for levels −1 and 0 only), the reason, where the box comes from (detector or hand), and the painting's pixelsSha256.

Seeded by the lettering detector and census (tools/maps/lib/atlas-detect.ts, atlas-labels.ts), then reviewed on the contact sheet (atlas.ts --review). When a listed painting changes, the build stops until its entries are reviewed again. Every hide entry is an alteration listed in the atlas NOTICE and manifest (D-042 O11).
